predeclared_plan.course_source: Module 2 minsearch vector retrieval and cohorts/2026/04-evaluation/homework.md Q6/Using this framework, pinned bc7b6aad6b92a5611d3d37bf7521a363f3b9d398.
predeclared_plan.purpose: Verify that the actual Retriever reconstructs the eligible saved-rank cutoff candidates, not merely a diagnostic calculation. Measure setup/search and serialized application-context size separately; character counts are not model tokens or context-fit proof.
predeclared_plan.controls: Unchanged source/corpus, frozen development questions/references, encoder model/revision/device/normalization/text, filters, generation settings and active config. Separate retriever initialization per candidate; model-cache access is local-only. Each candidate gets its stated cutoff; hybrid gets title0 and RRF1 exactly as the replay, with candidate depth20.
predeclared_plan.acceptance: All 84 returned ID lists and metrics match replay exactly. No missing/duplicate question rows. Verify encoder resolution/corpus/zero-truncation reports. Each known no-loss candidate remains only eligible for downstream model-capacity/answer comparison; a mismatch triggers investigation, never rewriting expected data. No promotion or claim of full core readiness.
predeclared_plan.failure_policy: Retain partial rows and failure type, terminal status and actual query attempts. No retries or concurrent duplicate run after timeout. Do not run missing-model downloads.
predeclared_plan.context_fit: Unproven; do not convert characters to assumed model tokens.
predeclared_plan.heldout_exposure: 42 development questions only; final bank previously readable/validated but no final inference/selection.
predeclared_plan.next_action: Run actual local offline retrieval once for each planned candidate/question. Inspect all mismatches and slice/resource tradeoffs; keep active config unchanged.

Thus, when ordering molecular testing of PHOX2B, it is important to know this limitation and communicate with the lab regarding test strategies to identify PARMs, NPARMs, and copy number variants. CCHS is an autosomal dominant inherited condition. Although in most cases, variants in PHOX2B occur de novo, some were reported to be inherited from one of the parents.
